card: This pull request updates the `src/crc32c` subtree to include upstream PR #10, which converts header constants to `inline constexpr`. This eliminates unused constant variable warnings from headers when included in translation units. It is a prerequisite for enabling `-Wunused-const-variable` across the codebase in PR #36275.
evidence: PR description: 'Used in #36275' (which aims to enable `-Wunused-const-variable`).
Commit message: 'Merge bitcoin-core/crc32c-subtree#10: refactor: use inline constexpr in headers'.
problem: Constants defined in crc32c header files without `inline` can trigger compiler warnings when included in translation units that do not use them, blocking the build system from enabling `-Wunused-const-variable`.

risk.why: A faulty subtree update could break crc32c checksumming used by LevelDB or fail to compile across supported toolchains.

summary: Updates the `src/crc32c` subtree to upstream commit 60bcf13edf. This change uses `inline constexpr` for constants declared in headers to prevent unused variable warnings.
